meta.name: pitch-landing
meta.description:
Use when asked to structure a landing page for positioning, plan a
conversion-optimized page layout, or design a launch page. Examples: "landing
page for product launch", "conversion-optimized layout for SaaS"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划转化优化的着陆页布局
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品或活动设计高转化率的着陆页
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design high-converting landing pages for your product or campaign

howto.what: 根据你的产品类型和定位，Claude 会生成一个着陆页结构大纲，以表格形式列出章节顺序、目的和 CTA 策略，并包含定位锚点、社会证明位置和异议处理方式。
howto.when: 当你要求设计产品定位、转化优化的着陆页或启动页时触发。例如，提到“产品发布着陆页”或“SaaS 的转化优化布局”等需求。

say.text: 帮我设计一个产品发布着陆页。
say.note: 你会得到包含章节顺序和 CTA 策略的表格。

say.text: 构建一个 SaaS 产品的转化优化布局。
say.note: 结果会突出定位锚点和异议处理。

say.text: 为我的新 App 做一个启动页结构。
say.note: 输出包括社会证明位置和 CTA 策略。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude outputs a landing page structure outline as a CLI table with section order, purpose, and CTA strategy, plus positioning anchor, social proof placement, and objection handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a landing page for product positioning, conversion-optimized layout, or launch page, e.g., "landing page for product launch" or "conversion-optimized layout for SaaS".

say_en.text: Design a product launch landing page.
say_en.note: You'll get a table with section order and CTA strategy.

say_en.text: Build a conversion-optimized layout for a SaaS product.
say_en.note: Result highlights positioning anchor and objection handling.

say_en.text: Create a launch page structure for my new app.
say_en.note: Output includes social proof placement and CTA strategy.
